Clementines are 14.20 a case now and the vine tomatoes 15.10, the new prices are out.
Round everyone to the nearest case, it's fairer than chopping bits off.

Saltings are still class C, that variation won't be through until January.
Treloar's moved up to class C this month, Hollis signed it off.
Minimum drop is off this week, the vans are going that way anyway.
Cos goes to anyone short of iceberg, no need to check the account.
Please don't reply in here about the allocation, I'll pick it up.
